MG006087-KG.about_this_item: Monge Natural Superpremium Mini Starter, богатый курицей — полнорационный корм для щенков мини-пород в период отъёма, а также для беременных и кормящих сук. Первый ингредиент — курица; свежее мясо, пребиотики XOS, глюкозамин и хондроитин, сбалансированное соотношение кальция и фосфора. Без искусственных красителей и консервантов.
MG006087-KG.ingredient_information:
Composition: Chicken (dried 30%, fresh meat 10%), rice, animal fat (chicken oil purified at 99.5%), dried beet pulp, hydrolysed animal proteins (liver), maize, brewers’ yeast inactivated, oats, dried eggs, fish (dried salmon), fish oil (salmon oil), minerals, yeasts products (mannan-oligosaccharides MOS 1%), xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS 0.3%), yucca schidigera (0.3%), algae meal (spirulina – Arthrospira platensis 0.3%), glucosamine (0.057%), chondroitin sulphate (0.04%).

Analytical constituents: Crude Protein: 32%, Crude Fibre: 1.5%, Crude Fat: 22%, Crude Ash: 7%, Calcium: 1.5%, Phosphorus: 1.1%, Calcium/Phosphorus = 1.3, n-3 Fatty Acids: 0.5%, n-6 Fatty Acids: 5.5%. Metabolisable Energy: 4,440 kcal/kg.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES/kg: Vitamin A (Retinyl Acetate) 30,700 IU, Vitamin D3 1,610 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl-acetate 3a700i) 72 mg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.4 mg) 0.2 mg, Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 92 mg) 30 mg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 174 mg) 140 mg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 47 mg) 12 mg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 304 mg) 100 mg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 2.4 mg) 1.6 mg, L-carnitine: 150 mg, DL-Methionine (Technically pure): 1,500 mg. TECHNOLOGICAL ADDITIVES: Antioxidants: Tocopherol extracts from vegetable oils.
MG006087-KG.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes (see table) may be split into 3 or more daily meals. Individual nutritional requirements may vary due to size, age and activity level of the animal. Be sure to have clean and fresh water available at all times. When this product replaces another type of feed and/or diet it is advised to introduce it gradually over a period of at least one week. Pet food only, not suitable for human consumption.
